name: Question 4
problem: Change the order of integration in the double integral ${\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}{\int }_{{e}^{y}}^{5}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y.$
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14071085/assets/7e0a0b1860f316f7954e85b9d7f6567d9e0c05bf316cb8af3901037abe6fd17e.png)

The diagram above shows the region of integration. It is a type II region, and its type II representation is

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le \operatorname{ln}⁡5,\,{e}^{y}\le x\le 5}.
$$

Notice that the top boundary of the region, written in the form $x=x(y),$ is

$$
x={e}^{y}\,⟹\,y=\operatorname{ln}⁡x,
$$

and the bottom boundary of the region is

$$
y=0.
$$

To change the order of integration, we write $D$ as a type I region. The type I representation of the region is

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,1\le x\le 5,\,0\le y\le \operatorname{ln}⁡x},
$$

as shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14071085/assets/3c95dd90ad02ab708f5893e47e7d7d0c8a212c18aed1972fb1bba1362181c383.png)

Therefore, swapping the order of integration, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}{\int }_{{e}^{y}}^{5}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y & ={\int }_{1}^{5}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡x}f(x,y)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 4
?

Change the order of integration in the double integral ∫0ln⁡5∫ey5f(x,y)dxdy.

a
∫e4∫ln⁡x2f(x,y)dydx
b
∫1e∫ln⁡x2f(x,y)dydx
c
∫24∫1ln⁡xf(x,y)dydx
d
∫15∫0ln⁡xf(x,y)dydx
e
∫15∫1ln⁡xf(x,y)dydx
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The diagram above shows the region of integration. It is a type II region, and its type II representation is D={(x,y):0≤y≤ln⁡5,ey≤x≤5}.

Notice that the top boundary of the region, written in the form x=x(y), is x=ey⟹y=ln⁡x, and the bottom boundary of the region is y=0.

To change the order of integration, we write D as a type I region. The type I representation of the region is D={(x,y):1≤x≤5,0≤y≤ln⁡x},

as shown in the diagram below.

Therefore, swapping the order of integration, we obtain ∫0ln⁡5∫ey5f(x,y)dxdy=∫15∫0ln⁡xf(x,y)dydx.
